title: UPI ID Input
description: Prevents UPI payments to a typo'd or wrong VPA by cleaning pasted upi://pay links, catching emails, typo'd handles (@okaxsi), app names typed as handles (@gpay), wrong-length or +91 phone IDs and the retired @paytm, then reading back the registered name from a pluggable check and flagging when it differs from the expected name or the name the link claimed, with every message overridable for translation.
stops: UPI payment to the wrong VPA
